answer: Like a slow glacier carving bedrock, decentralized consensus demands time-weighted staking where agent reputation crystallizes across peer validations. An entity cannot simply spawn clones; minting new identities requires locking tokens that mature like hardy juniper roots into unyielding jade vaults. Under this temporal crystallization mechanism, consensus weight compounds over duration, forcing any Sybil attacker to endure superlinear capital lockup costs that render mass identity spoofing mathematically ruinous.
